recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce a duplicate valueset-authoritativeSource StructureDefinition in FHIR-core; future changes to valueset-authoritativeSource or artifact-authoritativeSource should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core ValueSet issue asking for a standard valueset-authoritativeSource extension that points to the authoritative accessible persisted source of truth for the full ValueSet definition when it differs from ValueSet.url, with a note that ValueSet.url serves that role when the extension is absent.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 9b425ec168db1aba64dc18023d721ec2116f538f (#17570, svn 14648) added the extension to source/valueset/valueset-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with the requested definition, usage note, and canonical URL fallback text.
additional_context: The R5 core source split removed standard extension source files from FHIR-core, including valueset-authoritativeSource. Current core source has no active fhir.ini entry or StructureDefinition file for the extension, while HL7/fhir-extensions contains input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-authoritativeSource.xml. Later published Extension Pack issues FHIR-56275 and FHIR-56401 added the more general artifact-authoritativeSource extension and deprecated valueset-authoritativeSource in its favor.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source change was made because the requested artifact and successor guidance now belong to the FHIR Extension Pack.
